summary: Frontend-only test of the 4 improvements in the Chromium web preview at 390x844. Storage was seeded fresh in each session using /app/tests/e2e/setup_snippet.py. ALL REQUESTED FLOWS PASS, with 0 pageerrors. (1) Image auto-fit works. A gallery image of 1600x900 was inserted at x=20, w=350, h=196.9, so its right edge is at 370 = 390-20. A gallery image of 600x1200 was inserted at x=50, 150x300, inside the canvas. A project photo of 1600x900 was inserted at x=20, w=350. (2) Smooth drawing works. During a pen drag (mouse and CDP touch), a second 'live' SVG layer appears with the stroke path. After release, the live layer is removed and the stroke is committed to the main SVG. 3 strokes gave 'Elemente: 3'. The Rectangle, Circle and Line previews (Line after picking 'Linie' in the 'Linientyp wählen' picker) show in the live layer and commit correctly. Undo took the count from 3 to 2. Save showed the window.alert 'Success: Sketch saved'. Reopening via sketchId kept the elements: 2 elements, with the pen path and line rendered. (3) Select-mode regressions pass. The Polygon tool works: 4 taps plus a tap at the first point give a closed polyline. In Edit mode, tapping a segment opens the measurement numpad. Entering 5/4/5/4 and tapping 'Add' produces the labels 5m|4m|5m|4m and the legend 'S1 = 18 lfm • 20,00 m²', with a 20,00 m² badge, so the refactored polygonArea.ts works. The Position tool moves an inserted image: x/y changed from 50/50 to -10/-30. (4) The project PDF works. The HTML was taken from the PdfPreviewModal WebView props via the React fiber. On web, the WebView shows 'React Native WebView does not support this platform' (a known web limitation). The table 'Flächenübersicht (Skizzen)' lists TEST_Grundriss EG | S1 | 20,00 m² and Gesamt 20,00 m². Adding a seeded triangle sketch with sides 3/4/5 adds a row TEST_Dreieck S1 6,00 m² and Gesamt 26,00 m². The table is placed after the sketches container. A project whose closed polygon has only 3 of 4 sides measured shows NO table. (5) Calculator rename works. Main area 'TEST_Dach': tapping the underlined name in Berechnungsdetails opens the 'Name ändern' modal, with message 'Neuer Name für diese Grundfläche:' and the current name as default. Cancel keeps the old name. OK applies 'TEST_Hauptdach', and the Enter key also submits. A whitespace-only name keeps the previous name. Deduction 'TEST_Fenster' (NETTO 5.00 m²) shows message 'Neuer Name für diese Abzugsfläche:' and OK renames it to 'TEST_Gaube' in both the ABZÜGE and LINIEN PRO ABZUGSFLÄCHE sections. Touch targets are 44px high. (6) The web Alert polyfill still works: the save alert and the 'PDF Export' sequential confirm for 'Show preview' both work. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none in scope.

react_native_issues.issue: RenamePromptModal is a sibling <Modal> that opens while the 'Berechnungsdetails' Modal (showResultsModal) is still presented. On web it stacks correctly (verified). On iOS, presenting a second sibling RN Modal over an already presented Modal has historically failed to show or needed the first to close, so verify on a device. Reference: /app/frontend/app/calculator/new.tsx:8997 and :7172

action_items: Verify in Expo Go or TestFlight on iOS that 'Name ändern' appears above the open Berechnungsdetails modal. If it does not, render RenamePromptModal inside the results Modal, or close the results modal first and reopen it after rename.

Optional: HTML-escape sketch titles in the PDF Flächenübersicht table and the sketch-title paragraph. They are interpolated raw, so a title containing '<' or '&' breaks the markup. Reference: services/ProjectPdfService.ts:616 and :661

Optional perf: during live drawing on native the main Svg no longer remounts, but it still re-renders all elements on every move. Memoize the element list (useMemo over elements, lineSegmentMeasurements and selection) for really smooth drawing on large sketches.
Optional DRY: the same rename onPress is repeated 4 times in calculator/new.tsx (~7281, 7297, 7364, 7380). Extract it into a helper.
critical_code_review_comments: draw.tsx: mainCanvasKeyRef.current++ is a side effect during render, and the live layer uses key=fabricInvalidateTick.current++ on native, so the live layer remounts on every move. This is intended, but under StrictMode or concurrent rendering the keys may double-increment. It is harmless.

PDF area labels (S1..n) use the same filter as the sketch legend (getPolylineElementsWithMeasurements: polylines with at least 1 measurement). The numbering is consistent between sketch and PDF, as verified.
In Edit (select) mode, dragging an image does not move it. The Position tool is required, which works. This is likely by design (images live on the static layer). Mentioned for awareness only.
draw.tsx (9.6k lines), calculator/new.tsx (9k lines) and ProjectPdfService.ts (3.3k lines) are far over 700 lines. This is pre-existing.
seed_data_creation: Only browser localStorage in throwaway Playwright sessions (TEST_ customer/projects p1,p2, sketches, project photo ph1). No server or DB data touched.
